description: Commuters in South King County and East Pierce County will finally enjoy some congestion relief thanks to the transportation package passed by the Legislature last month. The centerpiece of the entire statewide package is the completion of SR 167, which will finally connect the freeway to Tacoma. On Monday, I briefed the Auburn City Council … Continued

title: Transportation package offers relief to Auburn drivers - Re-Elect Drew Stokesbary
